summary: Petty cash / expense lines split across multiple POs causing automatic payment hold
summary_impact: ~$12,300 in petty cash reimbursements and three vendor credit memos are blocked from payment processing by an automated PO-link validation rule.
description:
Issue summary:
Several petty-cash expense items and vendor credit memos were posted that reference two distinct PO numbers on the same reimbursement batch. The payments pipeline includes a validation that requires a single PO per disbursement; when multiple POs are present the batch is automatically flagged and placed on hold (PAY-HOLD-PO-MULTI).

Impact:
- 14 employee reimbursements (domestic) and 3 vendor credits (~$12,300 total) are on manual hold.
- Upcoming weekly payroll run unaffected, but next non-payroll vendor run will skip the held items unless released.
- Customer/partner refunds are delayed for 2 vendors until credit memos clear.

Environment:
- Production payment queue (prod-us-east).
- Accounting system: Redwood Finance v3.7.2 (batch processor 2025-12 build).

Steps to reproduce:
1) Create an expense report with line items assigned to PO-8241 and PO-9402 in a single reimbursement submission.
2) Submit batch to payments queue.
3) Batch validator flags multiple PO references and returns error PAY-HOLD-PO-MULTI, placing batch in "held" state.

Observed behavior / logs:
- Payment processor log excerpts: "validator: batch_id=BX-10023 status=held reason=PAY-HOLD-PO-MULTI"
- Queue UI shows holder tag and red flag on batch BX-10023.

Expected behavior:
- Either allow batch with mixed-PO lines to route (preferable with accounting tagging) or expose clearer UX/workflow to split and auto-route per-PO so payments are not blocked unexpectedly.

Immediate business ask:
- Finance needs a manual release for the current held batches and a short-term mitigant to avoid similar manual work each day while engineering investigates.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Khan: Created ticket after noticing hold during morning reconciliation. Attached batch IDs and screenshots in original email to #finance-helpdesk.
2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor (Finance Ops): Confirmed 3 vendor credits and 14 staff reimbursements are flagged. Requested full CSV export of batch BX-10023 and expense IDs.
2026-03-11 - Priya Patel (Payments): Can manually release these three batches today after approvals, but need dev to advise if this will re-trigger on next retry.

2026-03-11 - Marcelo Ortega (Payments Eng): Investigating validator logic—appears to be a strict constraint introduced in batch-validator v1.9 to simplify accounting matching. Suspect regression from change in 2025-11. Linking a potential related PR for review: github.com/redwood-inference/finance/PR#342

2026-03-12 - Priya Patel: Manual release performed for BX-10023 and BX-10024 after approvals (finance@). Noted two vendor credits required reconciliation entries post-release; work order FIN-2026-03 created.
2026-03-12 - Aisha Khan: Requesting timeline for automated fix; manual process is high-touch and error-prone when volume spikes.
investigation_notes: Validator behavior: batch-validator v1.9 enforces single-PO rule. Code branch 'single-po-enforce' added in PR#213 (2025-11) without a corresponding flag in finance settings.

Audit of last 90 days: ~0.8% of batches contained multiple PO references; usually split earlier by older UI workflow. Change in expenses UI in 2026-02 allowed mixed-PO submit which triggered this hole.

Immediate hypothesis: UX change + strict validator -> regression in production flow. Possible fixes: a) revert validator to warning + tag; b) enhance validator to auto-split batch into per-PO sub-batches and create related accounting entries; c) update UX to prevent mixed-PO submission.
Temporary mitigation implemented: payments team configured manual release policy for clearly vetted batches and added a finance approval queue. This prevents fail-stop but increases headcount touch.
Related: INT-22789 (aggregated-invoice-payrun-excluded-due-to-supplier-status-flag) contains a similar hold/unexpected-exclusion pattern; engineering to review for shared validator code paths.
resolution_notes: Manual release performed for current held batches on 2026-03-12; finance entries reconciled. Engineering postponed automatic resolution pending design decision. Next steps: schedule design session between Payments Eng, Finance Ops, and Product to pick preferred remediation. Created action item FIN-ENG-042.
next_steps: Schedule cross-functional design session (Payments Eng, Finance Ops, Product) by 2026-03-18.
Decide between: revert validator to warning, auto-split batches, or enforce UX constraint preventing mixed-PO submission.
If auto-split chosen: implement splitting logic in batch-processor and add audit links to original batch.
Add telemetry: count of mixed-PO submissions per week and hold rate; add dashboard tile (Console -> Finance -> Mixed PO Holds).
sla_notes: Internal ticket — finance manual release required within 48 hours to avoid vendor dissatisfaction. Not a customer SLA but business-impacting.
